name: Kinga Kollár - Proposition de décision du Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Amending Protocol to the Agreement between the European Union and the Swiss Confederation on the automatic exchange of financial account information to improve international tax compliance
part_text:
The European Parliament approves a new deal with Switzerland on sharing bank account information for tax purposes. The update brings Switzerland in line with new international rules that now cover electronic money and central bank digital currencies. It also lets the two sides help each other collect unpaid sales tax (VAT) and swaps old data protection references for the current EU privacy law. Parliament also asks both sides to look at extending this help to other taxes within four years.

- Switzerland and EU countries will automatically share more types of financial account data from 2026.
- It affects tax authorities and people holding accounts in Switzerland or the EU.
- Parliament has given its opinion; the Council can now formally conclude the deal.
